title: Quality Studio rule pack
description: A named selection of rules for one kind of project. Built-in packs are authored in rules/packs/*.json and generated into rule-packs.v1.json; custom packs live in .quality/rules/packs/<id>.json (project scope) or <data root>/rules/packs/<id>.json (global scope). A pack only selects rules; severity changes stay overrides with a reason.

id.description: Stable pack id. A custom pack file is named <id>.json; its id may not repeat a built-in or global pack id.

projectTypes.description: Free-form project types the pack is written for, shown when choosing packs.

include.description: A rule is selected when any selector matches it.

selector.description: Every property that is set must match; a list matches when the rule carries any of its values.
